d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Haiti vs Saudi Arabia in Group D of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Saudi Arabia came from behind to win 2-1 at Aspire Zone in Doha after Stephen Ramos fired Haiti ahead in the first half, with Abdullah Aldawsari equalising and Zaid Alburi striking the winner in the second half. Saudi Arabia finish second in Group D to reach the round of 32, while Haiti exit the tournament.
